title: Healthcare Utilization Analytics
problem_statement: A healthcare operations team needs a privacy-safe claims-style analysis of utilization, allowed charges, and service variation to test analytical workflows.
questions: Which service types drive utilization and charges?
Which findings are invalid for real beneficiaries?
hypotheses: Higher complexity is associated with higher allowed charges.
Return-visit rates vary by service type.
recommendations: Use the synthetic results only to validate pipelines and definitions.
Require clinically reviewed denominators and risk adjustment before operational action.
